title: The Riddle of the Missing Factor
story: Ombrelith the Shadow Ledger has stolen the town clock's gears and hidden them in identical velvet cases. He taunts Mr 6: 'I packed 8 gears into every case, and altogether I hid 152 gears — name my number of cases or the clock stays silent forever.' Mr 6 taps his sword thoughtfully against his own curly bottom loop.
question: What number times 8 gives 152?
hint: You need the missing factor: what do you multiply by 8 to reach 152? Division undoes multiplication.
victory: 'Nineteen,' said Mr 6, and every velvet case popped open at once like startled clams. Ombrelith folded into a thin ribbon of shade and slid away, muttering that he should have used a harder number.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight facing a tall shadowy ledger-keeper in a moonlit clock tower as nineteen velvet cases spring open spilling glinting brass gears.
